spirit:component.spirit:name: custom_axi_tg
spirit:component.spirit:description: Programmable AXI4 traffic generator for flit_endec test systems using pl_axi_cpi_bridge. Executes AXI4-Lite-loaded WRITE, READ and WAIT commands as aligned, single-beat 64-byte transactions with selectable address, ID, data and byte-enable patterns. Supports 2 to 512 commands, drain-on-stop, and per-command completion and response-error status.
